scheme_name: State Agriculture Thesis Grant for M.Sc. Agriculture
other_conditions: Applicants must be inhabitants of Nagaland who have passed the M.Sc. Agriculture programme
Applicants must be enrolled in an institution that has a valid AISHE/UDISE code
Applicants must not be a beneficiary of any other scholarship scheme
benefits_summary: Provides a thesis grant to eligible M.Sc. Agriculture students
